 p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=cwd,env=env or {**os.environ,'LC_ALL':'C'},capture_output=True,timeout=600)
 row={'label':label,'argv':cmd,'cwd':str(cwd),'status':p.returncode,'expected_status':expected,'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,3),'stdout_bytes':len(p.stdout),'stderr_bytes':len(p.stderr)}

  with LOG.open('ab') as f:
   f.write(('\n=== '+json.dumps(row)+' ===\nSTDOUT:\n').encode()+p.stdout+b'\nSTDERR:\n'+p.stderr+b'\n')

import sys, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, os, itertools, random, json, hashlib, shutil
TMP='/home/name/.hermes/cache/scratch'
def expected(data,n,text):
 # Independently enumerate line-start offsets, excluding EOF after trailing LF.
 starts=[0] if data else []
 starts += [i+1 for i,b in enumerate(data) if b==10 and i+1<len(data)]
 if 1<=n<=len(starts):
  k=starts[n-1];return data[:k]+text+b'\n'+data[k:]
 if n==len(starts)+1:return data+(b'\n' if data and data[-1]!=10 else b'')+text+b'\n'
 return None
def check(command,data,n,text,case):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='insert-oracle-',dir=TMP) as d:
  f=pathlib.Path(d)/'target';f.write_bytes(data);f.chmod(0o640)
  before=f.stat(); old=os.open(f,os.O_RDONLY)
  try:
   want=expected(data,n,text)
   p=subprocess.run([*command,'--json','target',str(n),os.fsdecode(text)],cwd=d,capture_output=True,timeout=15,env={**os.environ,'LC_ALL':'C'})
   got=f.read_bytes();after=f.stat()
   assert got==(data if want is None else want),f'EXACT_BYTE_MISMATCH case={case} n={n} original={data[:80]!r} expected={(data if want is None else want)[:80]!r} actual={got[:80]!r}'
   assert p.returncode==(1 if want is None else 0),(case,p.returncode,p.stderr)
   result=json.loads(p.stdout);assert result['path']=='target' and result['line']==n
   assert result['status']==('error' if want is None else 'ok')
   if want is not None:
    assert not p.stderr and result['message'] is None and after.st_ino!=before.st_ino
   else:
    assert p.stderr and after.st_ino==before.st_ino and after.st_mtime_ns==before.st_mtime_ns
   assert (before.st_mode,before.st_uid,before.st_gid)==(after.st_mode,after.st_uid,after.st_gid)
   assert os.read(old,len(data)+1)==data,'held descriptor content changed'
   assert [x.name for x in pathlib.Path(d).iterdir()]==['target']
  finally:os.close(old)
